title: SNOAR: Self-training with Noise filtering, Observation adding, and Remixing for Speech Denoising Without Clean References
abstract: arXiv:2610.20863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unsupervised speech denoising methods such as MixIT and noisy-target training can be trained directly on noisy recordings, avoiding the sim-to-real gap of synthetic training data, but remain well below supervised performance. Teacher--student self-training, as in RemixIT, narrows this gap by remixing a teacher's estimates into new mixtures that supervise a student; however, since the student is trained only toward the teacher's estimates, teacher errors, in particular over-suppressed speech, are never recovered and propagate as the teacher is updated from the student. We propose SNOAR, a self-training framework that corrects the teacher's estimates before use: the noise leaked into its speech estimate is removed by differential noise filtering (DNF), and part of the noisy observation is added back in to restore suppressed speech and attenuate artifacts. translated_title: SNOAR：无需干净参考的语音去噪自训练框架——噪声过滤、观测回加与混音
translated_abstract: 诸如 MixIT 和含噪目标训练等无监督语音去噪方法可以直接在含噪录音上进行训练，避免了合成训练数据带来的仿真到真实（sim-to-real）差距，但其性能仍远低于有监督方法。以 RemixIT 为代表的师生自训练方法通过将教师的估计结果重新混音成新的混合信号来监督学生，从而缩小了这一差距；然而，由于学生仅以教师的估计结果为目标进行训练，教师的错误（尤其是被过度抑制的语音）永远无法得到恢复，并且随着教师由学生更新而不断传播。我们提出了 SNOAR，这是一个在使用教师估计结果之前先对其进行校正的自训练框架：通过差分噪声过滤（DNF）去除泄漏到语音估计中的噪声，并将部分含噪观测信号加回，以恢复被抑制的语音并减弱伪影。我们证明这两种校正相互依赖，因为如果没有 DNF，该循环将崩溃（摘要此处截断）。
tldr: 提出 SNOAR 自训练框架，在使用教师估计结果之前先进行校正——用差分噪声过滤（DNF）去除泄漏噪声、并回加部分含噪观测以恢复被过度抑制的语音和减弱伪影，从而在无需干净参考语音的情况下显著提升自训练去噪性能。
en_tdlr: SNOAR is a teacher-student self-training framework for speech denoising without clean references that corrects teacher estimates before use—removing leaked noise via differential noise filtering and adding back part of the noisy observation—so as to recover over-suppressed speech and attenuate artifacts.
